d: Bizarre infrared returns, massive tree structures, and footsteps circling camp in the dark. This multi-season anthology brings together the most nerve-wracking encounters where researchers push past known boundaries to discover if can fresh evidence bring them closer to bigfoot? As sudden movement rustles through the canopy, every piece of incoming data raises the stakes: did new clues prove trackers are closing in after all these years? Witness the heart-pounding moments unfold and decide whether is this chilling sound proof of an encounter caught on tape.
